# Book a Day In

> > Book a Day In offers private guided tours and custom experiences in Paris, Madrid, and London with expert local guides and personalized itineraries.

Book a Day In (DayIn) specializes in private walking tours, museum visits with skip-the-line access, and full-day custom experiences across major European cities. The company serves both individual travelers and travel advisors, offering hotel pickup services, small group tours, and multilingual guides for iconic attractions like the Louvre, Eiffel Tower, and Montmartre.

## Key Topics

- Private guided tours
- Paris walking tours
- Louvre Museum tours
- Custom tour experiences
- Hotel pickup services
- Skip-the-line access
- Montmartre tours
- Eiffel Tower visits
- Le Marais neighborhood
- Notre-Dame Cathedral
- Madrid guided tours
- London attractions
- Travel advisor partnerships
- Small group tours
- Mona Lisa viewings

## Private Paris Tours

- [Paris: Private Paris Full-Day Tour | The Signature Custom Experience](https://www.bookadayin.com/tours/full-day-custom-paris): Full-day private Paris tour with Eiffel Tower, Louvre, Montmartre visits
- [Paris: Private Paris Half-Day Tour | A Focused Custom Experience](https://www.bookadayin.com/tours/half-day-custom-paris): Private 4-hour Paris tour covering Louvre, Eiffel Tower, Montmartre
- [Paris: Louvre Express Private Tour – Mona-Lisa & Must-Sees in 1 hour](https://www.bookadayin.com/tours/louvre-express-private-tour): 1-hour express Louvre tour featuring Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo
- [卢浮宫快车私人之旅 — 1 小时内蒙娜丽莎及必看景点](https://www.bookadayin.com/zh/tours/louvre-express-private-tour): Chinese language Louvre express tour page with Mona Lisa highlights
- [私享卢浮宫博物馆导览游（含酒店接送）](https://www.bookadayin.com/zh/tours/louvre-hotel-pickup): Private Louvre tour with hotel pickup service in Chinese language
